sn17.6:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| adhigamāya || || Kim bhikkhave asanivicakkaṃ taṃ sekham appattamānasam lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇāti ||
sn17.6:2.1: Asanivicakkanti kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasilokassetam adhivacanaṃ || || Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Chaṭṭhaṃ || ||
